dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Houston, this is Mark. I am on foot. Do you copy?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No response. Suit radio is breaking up. I will keep moving east.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Houston, I can barely hear you. Repeat that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Houston, signal is intermittent. I lost visual on the launch vehicle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I am still alive. Heading toward the rover beacon.

dialogue.speaker: houston
dialogue.text: Mark, Houston. We have your suit telemetry again. Keep walking.

dialogue.speaker: houston
dialogue.text: ...storm interference... crew abort... your signal was lost...

dialogue.speaker: houston
dialogue.text: The storm forced the crew to abort early. They lost your signal while you were moving toward the return rocket.

dialogue.speaker: houston
dialogue.text: Your vitals show you were unconscious for a while. The base was hit hard.

dialogue.speaker: houston
dialogue.text: Best option now: find the rover ahead. Reach it first. We are working the next plan.

dialogue.speaker: houston
dialogue.text: We see your signal near the rover. This is not your usual vehicle, so listen carefully.

dialogue.speaker: houston
dialogue.text: Push the throttle with G plus D. Use the fuel port and its button to load fuel cans into the tank.

dialogue.speaker: houston
dialogue.text: The auto pickup module was wrecked in the storm. For now you must carry fuel by hand.

dialogue.speaker: houston
dialogue.text: Some fuel cans were blown across the ground. Some fell from other rovers during the evacuation.

dialogue.speaker: houston
dialogue.text: Start the rover and drive forward. We will figure out the rest while you move.
